name: Shiva hippocampus signal (normal speed)
origin: Shiva software by Todd Murphy (signal templates licensed from Persinger and Koren)
summary: Murphy's simple Shiva session: the hippocampal 'LTP' signal stepped counter-clockwise around the head at normal speed, which the vendor calls 'the speed at which it was found to be the most effective in earlier lab studies'. The vendor presents it for cognitive, non-verbal, imagery and intuition effects. The waveform is rebuilt from descriptions.
notes: The vendor: 'Normal refers to the speed at which it was found to be the most effective in earlier lab studies' (hippocampus_page.htm). No page or paper gives the session's values. Vendor pages support 3-ms points and about 4 s of silence (rapid_&_high_speed_signals.htm) and 'approximately 9.6 (nine point six) seconds exposure' per minute (Shakti mono_proposal.htm). This file plays a rebuilt primed burst at 3-ms points: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]), then 4 s of silence. The eight coils sit on the vendor's Shiva ring and fire one at a time, counter-clockwise seen from above. Shiva has a coil pair at each position; one coil keeps the timing and covers about half the arc. The step of 10, 12 ... 20 ms per coil is this project's reading of a lecture example with no unit named (Murphy lecture 19:42-19:53). This session's step table is not published; lab runs of the amygdala signal used 20 to 6 ms and 100 to 30 ms (Saroka 2010 p.5 [470]) and 100 ms plus 20 ms per position (Collins 2014 p.40 [31]). The vendor gives no number for Shiva's field. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 24 uT at the scalp. Persinger, Richards & Koren 1994 tested an LTP pattern at 1 uT for 20 min, double blind, with another apparatus over the temporal lobes, not on a ring (p.1). The effect is a vendor claim. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Phase 1 alone is the 20-min version; with phase 2 it is the 30-min one. Murphy's cautions: with word-finding problems or feeling 'spaced out', switch to another signal; with headaches or pressure (about 2%), lower the intensity by one third. Not for people with epilepsy; stop if distressed.
setting: Dark, quiet room, eyes closed, relaxed without meditating or falling asleep. Shiva offers 20, 30 and 60-min versions; start with the short one.
schedule: At most once a week, never on consecutive days; up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break. 60-min sessions weekly or every two weeks at most.
